files.notes: Creates unique hashed password-reset tokens with expiry/use time, user cascade and lookup indexes; no plaintext reset token column in this table. Historical table is explicitly removed by0015, so this alone is not current reset policy proof.

Adds expiry nullable, revokes every existing predictable UUID5 token (is_active false, revoked_at coalesced, expires_at now), then makes expiry non-null and indexes it. Downgrade removes expiry only and does not reactivate revoked tokens; runtime entropy, scan validation and current retention require caller evidence.

Explicitly removes the legacy public-reset token table, with downgrade reconstructing its schema/indexes but no deleted rows. Historical intentional account-policy change; do not rewrite published script or describe this as a new data-loss vulnerability.

Rooming foundation fully read: hotels/rooms/preferences/assignments, check constraints for names/types/capacity/tags, hotel-room and passenger uniqueness, entity cascades and creator SETNULL. Individual entity FKs do not alone establish same-hotel/group/tenant or position-capacity invariants; later migrations/runtime must supply those guarantees before any active defect claim.

Adds non-null saved/order fields using temporary false/0 defaults, deterministically derives hotel-local row order from created_at and room_number, then removes defaults. Upgrade keeps existing rooms; populated PostgreSQL ordering/locking not executed.

Extends only room tag check with vip; downgrade restores the old check without normalizing vip rows. Source-confirmed conditional rollback compatibility candidate if persisted vip rows exist, not a demonstrated supported production rollback failure. Published script unchanged.

Creates check-in status/timestamp/key/welcome-letter/remarks records with agency/entity cascades, editor SETNULL and one hotel/passenger uniqueness. Later composite ownership constraints and service transitions are independent proof obligations; no source-only tenant bypass claim.

Adds nullable QR payload for office reprints; no automatic backfill or auth changes. Sensitive bearer-payload handling/retention must be established from actual current runtime and later schema, not inferred safe from the field alone.

Adds single-by-default family submission mode, nullable family relation/head/contact fields, family grouping index and false broadcast flag; preserves old rows. Shared family data security/tenant/retention semantics require service and later schema evidence.

Creates document distribution batch/item metadata and storage references with agency/group/batch cascades, nullable passenger SETNULL and indexed group/type/batch queries. Deleting relational rows alone does not prove object-store cleanup; current owner-authority and cross-column scope require later-chain/runtime trace.

Creates agency-owned rename batches/items with durable file/storage/match metadata, creator SETNULL and batch cascade; downgrade drops child before parent. Source schema does not itself validate storage key isolation or lifetime; current service and later migrations remain separate.

Adds required rename title using temporary Rename Batch server default for preexisting rows, then removes default; reversible column addition. No data-service qualification from manual source reading.

Adds agency_manager enum label inside explicit autocommit block and maps all legacy agency_staff rows to manager; downgrade maps manager back without removing enum label. Historical role transition preserved; no inference that current role authorization is permissive or correct from this alone.

WhatsApp broadcast groups/normalized recipients/logs have agency/entity cascades, group-phone uniqueness and query indexes; retained dashboard domain, separate from user-deferred Operations Inbox. Provider error text storage and cross-column ownership need current runtime/later schema evidence; no provider actions performed.

Adds nullable staff JSON metadata and two passport image storage-key columns; existing rows and object bytes untouched. Current sensitive-data validation and object cleanup not proven by additive schema.

Adds four false-by-default client-field flags and backfills the airport flag only for preexisting groups with nonempty departure-city arrays, preserving prior configured behavior. JSONB array shape is assumed from earlier application data; no live data or malformed-payload probing performed.

notes: All source lines physically read in two bounded outputs for0013–0028. Metadata and old passing tests are not manual read credit. All published bytes preserved. Shared outgoing authentication retained; no dedicated Inbox source investigation.
